tables.sobject_list:
CREATE TABLE sobject_list (
    id integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    code varchar(256),
    search_type varchar(256),
    search_id integer,
    keywords text,
    timestamp timestamp default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    project_code varchar(256),
    CONSTRAINT "sobject_list_code_idx" UNIQUE (code)
)
